d:
Another day, another song for Indra.
This one is in Bengali, the one of the sweetest languages of India. This however is not a prayer for miracles. This is an oath of excellence I want us to take. No amulets, no spells, no totka, no kundli, no fate written on the forehead. No yearning for moksha, mukti, liberation, or detachment. This is a calling for complete, absolute dedication to life in pursuit of excellence. With our own hands we resolve to shape our own line of fate, fall a thousand times and keep walking, and never settle for a little.
